reviewer: Codex quantum_coverage subagent; did not author the seven reviewed models

scope.focus: Wrong-class semantic failures and model-to-literature boundaries; not a repeat of the historical baseline census.

retained_checks.scope: Two general work-footprint lemmas plus13 concrete adversarial instances; they do not establish full model equivalence.

reviewed_failure_modes.risk: Uniformly weighting variable-depth leaves or granting a readable random tape
reviewed_failure_modes.evidence: Fresh bit per active transition;2^t padded tapes; unequal-depth example has3/4 mass; halted state is unchanged.

reviewed_failure_modes.risk: Ignoring space on rare/rejecting prefixes, or erasing visited cells to evade the bound
reviewed_failure_modes.evidence: Space is quantified over every prefix/configuration. General footprint monotonicity and one-step upper bound are independently proved.

reviewed_failure_modes.risk: US-style exact-one semantics or deduplicated accepting paths
reviewed_failure_modes.evidence: Count≤1 on every input; successor lists preserve duplicates and the sum counts them; extended horizon after halting keeps count2.

reviewed_failure_modes.risk: Uncomputable runtime bound or early-halting reachability loophole changes the language
reviewed_failure_modes.evidence: The bound certifies an all-branch polynomial clock. Any active path reaches the forbidden nonterminal horizon; acceptance and counts stabilize after all branches terminate. An explicit dominating polynomial can replace the bound.

reviewed_failure_modes.risk: Oracle chosen by input length, integer answers at unit cost, or hidden query encoding
reviewed_failure_modes.evidence: One fixed total oracle; one Boolean per query action; finite query word built locally. Blank compression is explicit and polynomial-time, with no added branches.

reviewed_failure_modes.risk: Input-dependent hierarchy depth or unrelativized outer-class substitution
reviewed_failure_modes.evidence: One existential Nat level per language, recursively defined PP oracle classes; no closure/collapse theorem is part of the definition.

reviewed_failure_modes.risk: Free input advice, arbitrary index arithmetic, shifted significance or wrong terminal alternation
reviewed_failure_modes.evidence: Fixed blank initialization and finite transition table; one-cell local writes; only input port is random access; independent address and fuel checks; explicit terminal answer.

reviewed_failure_modes.risk: Confusing U_E with direct-connection U_D uniformity or nonuniform NC1
reviewed_failure_modes.evidence: Operational endpoint is ALOGTIME. Buss§2 matches the random-access model; Behle etal2011 Remark1 is the explicit U_E/U_D warning.

reviewed_failure_modes.risk: Arbitrary predicates, real coefficients, hidden infinite assignments or malformed variables
reviewed_failure_modes.evidence: Finite ring/Boolean syntax; binary integer constants; Fin variableCount real witness; all references validated; malformed inputs rejected; real square-root and negative-square examples.

reviewed_failure_modes.risk: Noncomputable many-one reduction or exponentially succinct formula grammar
reviewed_failure_modes.evidence: Concrete total polynomial-time output transducer. Each instruction consumes operands, no DUP/macros, coefficient bits retain bit length; output-length theorem bounds encoding size.

reviewed_failure_modes.risk: Blank LSB-first index tape might require superlogarithmic input-length discovery
reviewed_failure_modes.evidence: Query zero for emptiness; shift a single1 right in two local transitions per exponent until out of range; clear it and greedily descend through lower bits once to compute n−1; synchronized ordinary-tape origin marker detects index position zero; one carry pass and return compute n. Constantly many traversals of O(log n) cells; no repeated rescanning or free arithmetic. This construction is mathematical, not a new kernel theorem.

trusted_unproved_bridges: Finite-control one-/multitape and binary-branching normalizations with the stated time/space resources
Fair-coin PL equals the positive-GapL characterization
P^PP=P^#P with polynomially many threshold queries, not one query
Standard fixed finite counting hierarchy and PP^P=PP
ALOGTIME equals U_E DLOGTIME-uniform NC1; binary address-convention simulations
Polynomial equivalence of the concrete postfix ETR language and standard finite-bit existential-real encodings
limitations: No calibrated probability of semantic error is derived from the number of checks.
No new inclusion/class separation or historical openness certification follows merely from this review.
The independent review module uses only core model imports and does not introduce an import cycle.
